comment: The layer is called the “foundational shared data layer,” but it contains both authoritative entity registries and the LHR, which holds or assembles clinical data. The category is clearer than “metadata registries,” but the distinct data responsibilities should be visible.

public.text: The layer is called the “foundational shared data layer,” but it contains both authoritative entity registries and the LHR, which holds or assembles clinical data. The category is clearer than “metadata registries,” but the distinct data responsibilities should be visible.
public.suggestedRevision: Subdivide the layer conceptually into authoritative entity references, longitudinal health-data capability, and semantic and structural foundations.
